I'm completely underwhelmed by this miracle product. I've been using this 2x daily for 2 months and am halfway through the bottle. The mucin irritated my skin initially; after the first 2 weeks, I started to notice a slight burning sensation when applying products to my face, just like when I first started using retinol. After doing more research and looking at Cosrx's own website, I'm convinced the main benefit of this is hydration and everything else is just marketing. I think users with dry skin will benefit, but since I have oily/combination skin, it doesn't help me. I also live in a hot and humid place. I might give this a second shot in the winter to see if my skin feels better, but for now, I don't plan to re buy.

Okay, let's talk about my holy grail serum: COSRX Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence. I've been using this for years—bought it online, grabbed it at Ulta, and never once had an issue. It's a skincare ride-or-die for my combination, clear-but-textured skin. First things first: yes, it's slimy. Like, actual snail vibes. If you have sensory issues, you might wanna patch test mentally before physically. 😂 But once you get past the texture—whew!—this stuff delivers. ✨ It pairs beautifully with The Ordinary Niacinamide (my old duo days), sinks in like a dream, and gives me that "glass skin" glow without feeling heavy or greasy. I use just a pump or two (a little goes a long way) and it lasts me 3+ months easy, even with daily use. And the bottle? Yeah, it looks small, but it's a deceptive queen—don't underestimate her. People literally stop me to ask what I use. "You're glowing!" "Your skin looks so smooth!"—thank you, snail slime. No stinging, no burning, no white cast. Just plump, juicy, lit-from-within skin. If you're on the fence, consider this your sign. 🐌💧

avis.titre: HELPED CLEAR UP MY SKIN SO WELL
avis.texte: After I started using snail mucin in my skincare routine I noticed so many changes. I used to have very oily skin and breakouts constantly but i found that this product has helped a lot with that
despite the fact that this brand is kind of a relic, I still think that snail essence is still a bomb.

I'm a fair skinned Latina and have dry, pretty nontextured skin, sometimes combo skin when it's hot in the summer. Was so excited to try this, have seen so many tiktok and youtube channels rave about this, but everytime id use it, id end up with textured skin. Usually i can run my finger around my face and its soft/smooth but everytime after using this, the next day, id have what felt like teeny tiny bumps/uneven texture. It never broke me out into pimples or anything, and it did do a good job at "firming" the skin where it felt like the moisturizing propreties were doing their job correctly, but the feeling of textured bumps underneath the skin was enough to get me to stop using it. Since having stopped using it, my skins smooth again/no texture. Just writing a review to remind that not everything we see being raved about will work for your skin type necessarily.

I am on the spectrum and precise product output means a lot to me because, otherwise, I have to talk myself out of not freaking out. My beauty products need to have a pump or they need to be easy for me to evenly count. I think in numbers. Two pumps/applications works wonders! I love the even glassy look it provides. I love that it layers well with other products, regardless of brand or product type. Keep up the good work!

I usually use this product at night. Its very hydrating and I love that for the nighttime. I like to add moisturizer on too of it after about 5-10 minutes to lock it in (not sure that really does anything but i like to think it does?). It also brightens my skin tone and makes it look firm.
